sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, 
which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Abd El-Satar, 
EEHC technical inspection & quality control head sector, and from TL 
instructions document, 
this document certified by by eng. MPIS 
zone coordinators

Safety 
Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category.

Maintenance staff should be well trained, qualified or 
 directly supervised by some one who is.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear the personal protective equipment must used as safety 
 shoes, safety helmet, earplug, and gloves pairs...etc

sections.text:
Tools and 
Equipment

Safety and healthy equipment as 
 safety harnesses, cotton suit,... etc
Work to be Carried out

Make certain that the dies for aluminum and steel correspond to the prescribed 
sizes

Check whether the bores of the individual elements dead end body, steel terminal 
and jumper terminal are thoroughly
Be sure that the conductor end is not damaged if so, cut off the damaged portion

Insert the conductor into the dead end and slip it over the conductor for one 
meter approx

Serve the conductor (with metallic wire, or suitable tape) at about 3 cm. off 
the end, and with a hacksaw cut off the aluminum mantle wires near the serving 
(figure. 8.a) taking care not to nick steel core wires
Serve the steel core end (figure. 8-b)

Serve the conductor mantle at a distance from the core end equal to the depth of 
the eye end liole plus 25%

Cut off the aluminum wires just in front of the last serving (figure 8-c) always 
taking care not to nick the core wires. To avoid such nicking, saw the outer 
layers of mantle cut only for 2/3 of diameter the inner layer of aluminum wires 
which will be detached by a repeated bending movement

Mark the core (new undressed from aluminum wires) at a distance equal to the 
depth of the eye end bore, insert the core 2 cm into the steel terminal and 
remove serving put off the serving then by means of a plier and insert 
thoroughly the core making sure that it has entered up to the mark made before 
to carry out easily this operation, keep hold of the steel terminal by pressing 
it slightly between the dies fitted on the compressor

Compress the cylindrical part of the steel terminal starting 8-d) and continue 
the compressions towards the conductor overlapping one half of each compression 
and making sure every time that the two half dies barrel together

Clean thoroughly all aluminum wires of the conductor portion that has to be 
compressed. This is particularly important and is to be made by winding the 
various wire layers in case of greased or old and blackened conductor in the 
first case a suitable solvent may be used in the latter case use an emery cloth 
or metallic brush having steel wires 2 to 3/10 mm long

Slip the dead end body over the eye end, taking off obviously the serving, until 
the polygonal part of come is thoroughly inserted in the corresponding dead end 
seat (fig. 8-e) ensure the right orientation of the steel terminal in 
respect to the position of the lug

Compress the first portion of the dead end, namely that on the steel terminal 
side (fig. 8-f) starting from the reference line marked on purpose overlapping 
one half of each compression as written at point 10

Compress the second portion of the dead end starting from the reference mark and 
continue compressions toward the conductor (fig. 8-g) proceeding as written at 
points 10 and 13

Clean very accurately as mentioned at point 11 all aluminum wires of the 
conductor end having to be inserted into the jumper terminal

Insert thoroughly the conductor into the jumper terminal then start compressions 
from lug side (figure 8-h) and proceed as previously described

Clean perfectly the contact surfaces of dead end lug and of jumper terminal by 
abrading with emery-cloth or metallic brush and finally bolt the two parts with 
each ether.
